models.name: shopping_mall_configs
models.description:
Global configuration entries for the shoppingMall platform.

Stores low-level key/value style configuration items grouped by namespace. Each row represents a single configuration key with its current value, used for feature toggles, numeric thresholds, and string parameters referenced by multiple subsystems.

Configs are managed primarily by platform administrators and are intended to be relatively static, with updates happening infrequently and under change control. Historical behavior for orders, payments, and reviews is preserved in their own domains by recording effective values or referencing specific policy records instead of retroactively changing past data.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the configuration entry.

plainFields.name: namespace
plainFields.description: Logical namespace that groups related configuration keys, such as "checkout", "payment", or "reviews". Used to organize configs and simplify lookups.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key within a namespace, such as "max_cart_items" or "payment_timeout_seconds".

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value serialized as text. The consuming subsystem is responsible for interpreting the value as boolean, number, JSON, or other structured type.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration key and how it is used across the platform.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this configuration row is currently considered active for runtime evaluation. Inactive rows remain for audit and potential rollback.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the configuration row is logically removed from active use but preserved for audit.

uniqueIndexes.description: Ensures that each configuration key is unique within its namespace.

plainIndexes.description: Supports queries that retrieve all active configs within a namespace without indexing the value itself.

ginIndexes.description: GIN index for text search over configuration descriptions to help administrators find specific settings by keywords.

models.name: shopping_mall_policy_settings
models.description:
High-level policy groups and configuration profiles for the shoppingMall platform.

Represents named collections of rules or parameters that describe how the platform behaves in different contexts, such as default cancellation windows, review time windows, or fraud-related thresholds. These settings are referenced by domain-specific policy tables and can be used as building blocks for more detailed rules.

Each policy setting is identified by a code and can be activated or deactivated independently, allowing platform administrators to prepare future configurations and switch between them in a controlled way.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the policy setting.

plainFields.name: code

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: config_payload

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this policy setting profile is active and can be referenced by domain-specific policies.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp from which this policy setting becomes effective. Allows scheduling of policy changes.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp after which this policy setting is no longer considered effective.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this policy setting profile was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this policy setting profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the profile is no longer available for new references but remains for historical audit.

uniqueIndexes.description: Enforces uniqueness of the business identifier for policy setting profiles.

plainIndexes.description: Supports queries that look up active policy setting profiles by category.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_policies
models.description:
Cancellation policy definitions for shoppingMall orders.

Each record describes how cancellations should be handled for a particular business context, including allowed time windows, conditions, and any associated configuration profile. These policies are referenced by the order and payment domains when processing customer- or seller-initiated cancellation requests.

Policies can be scoped by region and can be activated or deactivated over time. Historical orders and requests should store references to specific policies rather than relying on current defaults.

primaryField.description: Primary key for the cancellation policy.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_region_setting_id

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_policy_setting_id

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_policies

Refund policy definitions for orders and payments in shoppingMall.

Each record describes how refunds should be processed in different business contexts, including allowed refund windows, full vs partial refund behavior, and eligibility rules. The payment and order subsystems reference these policies when handling refund requests, returns, and admin interventions.

Refund policies can be scoped by region and may link to shared policy setting profiles. Historical records reference specific policies to preserve the rules that were in force at the time of the transaction.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_policies
models.description:
Review and rating policy definitions for the shoppingMall platform.

Each record defines rules governing product reviews and ratings, including eligibility, time windows, content restrictions, and moderation behavior. Review subsystems consult these policies when allowing customers to create, edit, or delete reviews, and when evaluating reports and moderation thresholds.

Policies can be scoped by region and may reference shared configuration profiles. Historical review records can store references to specific policies to preserve the criteria that applied when the review was created or moderated.

Defines rules controlling access to age-restricted or otherwise sensitive products based on customer age, region, and other eligibility criteria. Catalog, checkout, and review subsystems reference these policies to determine whether a customer may view, purchase, or review restricted items.

Policies may be tied to specific regions and configuration profiles, enabling different legal and regulatory requirements across markets.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Category nodes within a specific category tree for the shoppingMall catalog.

Each record represents a single category in a tree, with optional parent linkage to form a hierarchy. Categories hold display names, slugs, and ordering information. They can be activated or deactivated without deleting underlying products, allowing the catalog to evolve.

Categories reference {@link shopping_mall_category_trees} to support multiple parallel trees. They provide the taxonomy backbone for products and influence search, filtering, and catalog navigation behavior across the platform.

models.name: shopping_mall_guestuser

models.name: shopping_mall_platformadmin

Platform administrator accounts with elevated privileges to operate and moderate the marketplace.

Authentication sessions for customer actors used to trace login context across requests.

Each record represents one authenticated session belonging to a customer, linked to {@link shopping_mall_customer}. The table follows the strict session pattern: minimal connection metadata, creation time, and optional expiry time.

Sessions are used for authorization context, audit trails, and security analytics but are managed as supporting entities rather than business objects.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the customer session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the owning customer account. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address captured when the session was established. Used for security analytics and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL or path that initiated the authenticated session, such as the login page or entry route.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring URL when the session was created, used for tracing login sources and campaigns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated. Null for still-active sessions.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for seller actors used to track merchant activity and security context.

Each record represents a single authenticated session for a seller, referencing {@link shopping_mall_seller}. The schema follows the global session pattern with minimal connection metadata and temporal fields.

These sessions allow investigation of inventory changes, catalog modifications, and order updates in conjunction with audit logs from other components.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the seller session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the owning seller account. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the seller session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Entry URL that initiated the seller login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at the time of seller login creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller session started.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller session expired or was explicitly terminated. Null while still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_platformadmin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for platform administrator actors.

Each record represents one authenticated admin session associated with {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin}. The table strictly follows the standardized session schema to keep security-critical session data minimal and consistent.

These sessions are fundamental for correlating high-impact admin actions with connection context in audit and security analysis.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the platform admin session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the owning platform administrator account. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address seen when the admin session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Entry URL that initiated the admin login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at the time of admin login creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session expired or was explicitly invalidated. Null for active sessions.

models.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials
models.description:
Authentication credentials for all persistent actor types in the platform.

This table centralizes login identifiers and password hashes for customers, sellers, and platform administrators. Each row defines how one actor authenticates to the system and serves as the root entity for credential-related subtype records.

Actor ownership is modeled through dedicated subtype tables such as {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials_of_customers}, {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials_of_sellers}, and {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials_of_platformadmins}. This avoids multiple nullable foreign keys and enforces that each credentials record belongs to exactly one actor type based on the actor_type field.

Security events and risk flags reference this table for identity-centric analysis and decision-making.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the credentials record.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor this credential belongs to, such as customer, seller, or platformAdmin. Used for authorization routing and to select the appropriate subtype entity that links to the concrete actor record.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Login email identifier associated with this credential. Must be unique within the scope of actor_type and the owning actor according to platform policy.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure non-reversible representation of the actor’s password used for authentication. Plain text passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Credential status such as active, locked, or compromised. Controls whether authentication using this record is allowed.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login using these credentials, or null if no login has occurred yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the credential record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the credential record was last updated, for example when rotating password hashes or changing status.

models.name: shopping_mall_email_verification_tokens
models.description:
Email verification tokens used to confirm ownership of email addresses for actors.

Each token references a credentials record in {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials} and captures the lifecycle of verification, including expiry and consumption timestamps.

These tokens support customer, seller, and admin onboarding flows as well as email change confirmations while preserving auditability of verification attempts.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the email verification token.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the credentials record whose email is being verified. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque verification token sent to the user via email. Must be unique to safely locate the verification attempt.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the token is no longer valid for verification.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to complete email verification. Null while pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was created and dispatched.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token record was last updated, typically when marked as consumed or expired by background jobs.

models.name: shopping_mall_password_reset_tokens
models.description:
Password reset tokens that allow actors to set new credentials after passing ownership checks.

Each token is associated with {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials} and includes validity and consumption metadata. The system never stores the new password in this table, only the reset workflow identifiers.

Tokens can be invalidated or expired according to security policies and are crucial evidence for audit and breach investigations.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the password reset token.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the credentials record whose password is being reset. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque password reset token delivered via secure channel. Must be unique to prevent collisions and guessing attacks.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the reset token is no longer valid and must not be accepted by the system.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to complete a password reset operation. Null while still pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token record was last updated, usually when consumed or invalidated.

models.name: shopping_mall_risk_flags
models.description:
Risk and fraud-related flags attached to actor credentials to influence authorization and operations.

Each record represents a specific risk assessment or incident tied to {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials}, such as suspected fraud or abuse. Business rules use these flags to tighten security, require manual review, or restrict actions.

Historical records allow risk teams and admins to analyze patterns, even after a flag has been cleared.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the risk flag entry.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the credentials record this risk flag applies to. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}.

plainFields.name: risk_level
plainFields.description: Risk severity level such as low, medium, high, or critical indicating the strength of the concern.

plainFields.name: reason_category
plainFields.description: Categorized reason for the risk flag such as suspected_fraud, abuse_reports, chargeback_history, or account_compromise.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this risk flag is currently active and should influence authorization decisions.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-form notes describing the context or evidence behind the risk assessment for internal teams.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the risk flag was created.

plainFields.name: cleared_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the risk flag was cleared or downgraded, or null if the flag is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_roles
models.description:
Role definitions for platform administrators that determine available admin capabilities.

Each row represents a reusable role such as super_admin, support_agent, or risk_analyst that aggregates permissions outside this schema. Roles are assigned to admin accounts via {@link shopping_mall_admin_role_assignments}.

This table is central to the least-privilege model and supports independent lifecycle management and auditing of administrative responsibilities.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the admin role definition.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Short machine-friendly code for the admin role, such as SUPER_ADMIN or SUPPORT_AGENT. Must be unique.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name for the admin role presented in admin dashboards.

plainFields.name: description_text
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of what responsibilities and permissions this role entails.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin role definition was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the role is no longer assignable but remains for historical references.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_role_assignments
models.description:
Assignments of admin roles to specific platform administrator accounts.

This junction table links {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin} records with {@link shopping_mall_admin_roles} to express which roles each admin has at any given time.

Assignments support start and end timestamps to enable time-bounded responsibilities and to reconstruct historical permission sets for audit and compliance.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the admin role assignment.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the platform administrator who receives the role. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_role_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the admin role being assigned. {@link shopping_mall_admin_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: assigned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role assignment became effective for the admin.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role assignment was revoked or expired, or null if it is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_security_events
models.description:
Security-related events associated with identities and sessions for monitoring and forensics.

Each row records one significant security event, such as login success, login failure, password change, token misuse, or suspicious activity. Events may reference {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials} when an identity can be resolved.

This table is not a full audit log for all business operations but focuses on authentication, authorization, and security anomalies important for risk and compliance reporting.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the security event.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Optional foreign key to the credentials record involved in the event when identifiable. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor involved in the event such as customer, seller, platformAdmin, or guestUser. Null when the actor could not be resolved.

plainFields.name: actor_identifier
plainFields.description: Non-sensitive identifier for the actor such as email or a masked login identifier, used only when credentials cannot be linked directly.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Machine-friendly category for the security event such as LOGIN_SUCCESS, LOGIN_FAILURE, PASSWORD_RESET_REQUEST, or TOKEN_REVOKED.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed for this security event, used in threat detection and analysis.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string or normalized device descriptor associated with this event.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional JSON-encoded or structured text payload containing additional context for the event, such as error codes or geo information.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the security event was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_of_customers
models.description:
Subtype entity connecting authentication credentials to customer actors.

Each record represents the ownership of a {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials} row by a specific {@link shopping_mall_customer}. It enforces a 1:1 relationship between credentials and customer while keeping the main credentials table free of multiple nullable foreign keys.

This table is treated as a supporting entity and is managed by authentication and account management flows rather than directly by end users.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the customer credentials subtype record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the root credentials record associated with this customer. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}. Enforced as unique to maintain a 1:1 relationship.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the owning customer account. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this customer-credentials link was created, typically at registration or when credentials were first attached to the customer account.

models.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_of_sellers
models.description:
Subtype entity connecting authentication credentials to seller actors.

Each record represents the ownership of a {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials} row by a specific {@link shopping_mall_seller}. This implements the polymorphic ownership pattern without multiple nullable foreign keys in the main credentials table.

The table is a supporting entity and is created and updated by seller onboarding and account management workflows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the seller credentials subtype record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the root credentials record associated with this seller. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}. Enforced as unique to maintain a 1:1 relationship.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the owning seller account. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller-credentials link was created, usually during seller registration or credential assignment.

models.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_of_platformadmins
models.description:
Subtype entity connecting authentication credentials to platform administrator actors.

Each record represents the ownership of a {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials} row by a specific {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin}. This pattern ensures strict normalization by separating admin-specific ownership data from the main credentials table.

The table is managed through admin provisioning processes and supports precise auditability for sensitive administrative access.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the platform admin credentials subtype record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_auth_credentials_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the root credentials record associated with this administrator. {@link shopping_mall_auth_credentials.id}. Enforced as unique to maintain a 1:1 relationship.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to the owning platform admin account. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this platform-admin-credentials link was created, typically during admin account provisioning.

models.name: shopping_mall_brands
models.description:
Brand entities used to label products in the catalog.

Represents manufacturers, labels, or store brands that own or market products. Brands are shared across many products and can be searched and filtered independently.

Brand information is global and is not tied to a specific seller account, although business policy may restrict which sellers can use which brands. Historical references from orders and reviews rely on brand data remaining available, so soft deletion is supported.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the brand record.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the brand. Must be unique across the platform for consistent filtering and search.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier for the brand, typically derived from the name. Used in catalog routing and SEO contexts.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive text about the brand, presented on brand landing pages or product detail sections.

plainFields.name: logo_uri
plainFields.description: URI pointing to the primary brand logo image stored in a media service or CDN.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the brand record was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the brand record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the brand was soft-deleted. Null when the brand is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product definitions in the shoppingMall catalog.

Each product groups one or more purchasable SKUs under a common name, descriptions, media, and category associations. Products belong to exactly one seller and may optionally reference a brand.

Product lifecycle and visibility (draft, active, inactive, discontinued) are driven by status and related visibility/compliance rules. SKUs hold price and inventory links, while catalog products provide the structure used for browsing and search.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller for this product. Links the catalog entry to a single merchant entity. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_brand_id
foreignFields.description: Optional brand associated with this product. If null, the product may be treated as unbranded or seller-branded. {@link shopping_mall_brands.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business-visible product code or identifier used internally and in integrations. Unique per platform for stable references.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Primary product name displayed in catalog listings and product detail pages.

plainFields.name: short_description
plainFields.description: Short description or tagline suitable for list views and summaries.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Full product description used on product detail pages. May include rich-text content serialized as text.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the product such as draft, pending_review, active, inactive, or discontinued. Business logic constrains allowed values.

plainFields.name: is_multi_sku
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this product has multiple SKUs (variants). If false, the product typically has a single SKU.

plainFields.name: primary_image_uri
plainFields.description: URI of the primary image displayed in listings. A convenience pointer to one of the media records or an external image.

plainFields.name: additional_data
plainFields.description: Optional JSON-encoded metadata string for custom catalog attributes not modeled as separate fields.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted. Null when the product is active in the catalog.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_category_assignments
models.description:
Junction table linking products to categories in the catalog hierarchy.

Represents both primary and secondary category associations for a product. This allows products to appear under multiple categories for navigation and search while delegating category structure to the separate categories component.

Assignments are maintained by sellers or admins and are used heavily in catalog browsing and filtering.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the category assignment record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that is assigned to the category. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Target category under which the product should appear. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this category is the primary category for the product. Only one assignment per product should typically be primary.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category assignment was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_media
models.description:
Media assets associated with catalog products.

Stores references to images or other media files used in product listings and detail pages. Each record points to one media asset and includes ordering information and role flags such as whether it is featured.

Media URIs are typically stored in object storage or a CDN, and this table only holds references and metadata.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product media record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product to which this media asset belongs. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: uri
plainFields.description: URI pointing to the media asset (image, video thumbnail, etc.) in storage or CDN.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Optional alternative text describing the media asset for accessibility and SEO.

plainFields.name: media_type
plainFields.description: Type of media such as image, video, or other supported categories. Business rules define allowed values.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order index used to sort media assets for display. Lower numbers usually appear first.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this media asset is the primary one for the product, typically reflected in primary_image_uri on the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the media record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the media record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the media record was soft-deleted. Null when the media is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_option_types
models.description:
Option dimensions that define variant structures for a product.

Each record represents an option type such as color, size, material, or style, scoped to a single product. Option types organize option values and drive variant selection UI and SKU composition.

Option types are only meaningful in the context of their product and are managed when defining or editing product variants.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product option type record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that owns this option type. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the option type, such as "Color" or "Size". Unique per product.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name or label shown in UI. When null, the name value is typically used.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Ordering index specifying the sequence in which option types appear for the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option type was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option type was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option type was soft-deleted. Null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_option_values
models.description:
Concrete option values under a product's option types.

Each record represents a selectable value such as "Red", "Blue", "Small", or "XL" associated with a specific option type. These values are combined through SKU option assignments to define distinct purchasable variants.

Option values are scoped to a product via their option type and participate in SKU uniqueness constraints when composing variant combinations.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product option value record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_option_type_id
foreignFields.description: Parent option type that this value belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_option_types.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Canonical value label such as "Red" or "XL". Unique per option type.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display label for this value, allowing localized or user-friendly text.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Ordering index specifying how values are presented within the option type.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was soft-deleted. Null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_skus
models.description:
Purchasable product variants represented as SKUs.

Each SKU corresponds to a concrete combination of option values (such as a specific color and size) for a product and carries pricing information and lifecycle status. Inventory quantities and reservations are handled in the Inventory component, but SKUs provide the catalog-facing identity for those records.

SKUs are the unit of cart lines, order lines, and inventory tracking; prices, compare-at prices, and SKU-level status determine availability in the catalog and checkout flows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the SKU record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this SKU belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business-defined SKU code used in inventory systems and order line references. Unique per product.

plainFields.name: external_code
plainFields.description: Optional external code such as a seller-specific identifier or marketplace reference.

plainFields.name: barcode
plainFields.description: Optional machine-readable code such as UPC or EAN for scanning and logistics.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the SKU such as active, inactive, or discontinued. Determines catalog and checkout eligibility together with product and inventory status.

plainFields.name: price_amount
plainFields.description: Current unit price for the SKU in the platform’s base currency or in a currency defined elsewhere.

plainFields.name: compare_at_price_amount
plainFields.description: Optional original or reference price used to display discounts when lower than this value.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Currency code for price fields, such as USD or EUR. The allowed set is managed by configuration tables.

plainFields.name: additional_data
plainFields.description: Optional JSON-encoded metadata for SKU-level catalog attributes beyond standard fields.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was soft-deleted. Null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_option_value_assignments
models.description:
Assignments connecting SKUs to specific option values.

Represents the mapping from a SKU to the set of option values (for example, Color: Red, Size: M) that define its variant combination. This structure allows flexible modeling of multi-dimensional options while enforcing uniqueness of combinations per product.

Assignments are used to reconstruct variant selections in UI and to validate that each SKU corresponds to a unique combination of values under its product.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the SKU option value assignment record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU that this option value is assigned to. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_option_value_id
foreignFields.description: Option value that participates in the SKU’s variant combination. {@link shopping_mall_product_option_values.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the assignment was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_visibility_rules
models.description:
Per-product visibility configuration for regions and channels.

Encapsulates rules that determine where and to whom a product is visible in the catalog. Rules may specify region constraints, sales channels, and override visibility states relative to the product’s base lifecycle status.

This table enables flexible configurations such as region-restricted products, channel-specific offerings, or temporary hiding in certain markets without changing the core product status.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product visibility rule record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this visibility rule applies to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_region_setting_id
foreignFields.description: Optional region settings record that scopes this rule to a specific geographic region. Null means the rule is global. {@link shopping_mall_region_settings.id}.

plainFields.name: channel
plainFields.description: Optional sales channel identifier such as web, mobile, or marketplace. Null indicates the rule is not channel-specific.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility effect of this rule, such as visible, hidden, or restricted. Combined with product status and compliance flags to determine final exposure.

plainFields.name: starts_at
plainFields.description: Optional start timestamp from which the rule becomes effective. Null means it is effective immediately.

plainFields.name: ends_at
plainFields.description: Optional end timestamp after which the rule no longer applies. Null means it has no scheduled end.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the visibility rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the visibility rule was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_compliance_flags
models.description:
Compliance and restriction metadata applied to products.

Captures regulatory and policy-related flags such as age restrictions, hazardous materials indicators, region-based sales restrictions, or custom policy tags. These flags influence catalog visibility, checkout eligibility, and downstream processes in other domains.

Compliance flags are additive and may be combined to express multiple restrictions on a single product. They are managed primarily by admins or trusted sellers according to platform policy.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product compliance flag record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this compliance flag applies to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_age_restriction_policy_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to a predefined age restriction policy that applies to this product. {@link shopping_mall_age_restriction_policies.id}.

plainFields.name: flag_type
plainFields.description: Type of compliance flag such as age_restriction, hazardous_material, or region_restricted. Business configuration defines valid values.

plainFields.name: flag_value
plainFields.description: Optional detailed value for the flag, such as a specific regulation code or descriptive tag.

plainFields.name: is_blocking_sale
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this flag blocks sale entirely under certain conditions or only affects visibility and messaging.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional internal notes describing why this flag was applied or additional regulatory context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the compliance flag was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the compliance flag was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest_carts
models.description:
Temporary shopping carts owned by unauthenticated guest users.

Represents a transient cart created when a guestUser first adds an item before registration or login. Each guest cart is bound to an anonymous token and basic context such as originating URL, allowing later association with a customer account during registration or login.

Guest carts are persisted for a configurable retention window for continuity and analytics. They do not carry any payment or order state; once checkout completes and an order is created, the cart can be cleared or soft-deleted without affecting historical orders.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest cart. Uniquely identifies a temporary cart instance for a guestUser.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to a guest user record if the platform maintains guest identities. {@link shopping_mall_guestuser.id}.

plainFields.name: guest_token
plainFields.description: Opaque anonymous token that identifies the guest cart within a browser/session context. Used to retrieve the cart for an unauthenticated visitor.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address captured when the guest cart was created or last significantly modified. Used for security analysis and geo-based business rules.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Optional user agent string or a truncated representation, used for analytics and troubleshooting guest cart behavior.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Initial referrer URL when the cart was first created, if available. Helps understand acquisition and funnel behavior.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest cart was last updated (for example, item added or removed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates that the guest cart has been logically removed or expired but kept for audit or analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest_cart_items
models.description:
Line items belonging to a guest cart, representing SKU selections and quantities.

Each record corresponds to a single SKU that a guestUser intends to purchase. Items depend entirely on their parent guest cart and are removed or updated when the guest modifies the cart or when the cart expires.

This table does not store prices or discounts, as cart pricing is derived at read time and firmly recorded only when orders are created.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest cart item. Uniquely identifies a specific SKU entry within a guest cart.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guest_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent guest cart that owns this item. {@link shopping_mall_guest_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the base catalog product for this item. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific SKU variant (for example, size and color) that the guest selected. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Requested quantity of the SKU in the guest cart. Must be a positive integer constrained by inventory and business limits at application level.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was first added to the guest cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated, such as quantity changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates that the item has been logically removed from the cart but optionally retained for audit or analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_carts
models.description:
Persistent shopping carts owned by authenticated customers.

Represents the main cart that a customer maintains across sessions and devices. Each customer normally has at most one active persistent cart, which can be merged with guest carts during registration or login.

Customer carts hold no payment or order state. When checkout completes and an order is created, application logic may clear the cart, update timestamps, or soft-delete the cart while preserving audit history.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the customer cart. Uniquely identifies a persistent cart instance associated with a customer.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated customer who owns this cart. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this cart is currently considered active for the customer. Used to support scenarios with archived or historical carts.

plainFields.name: source_guest_token
plainFields.description: Optional anonymous token from a source guest cart that was merged into this customer cart. Useful for tracing guest-to-customer conversions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer cart was last updated, such as when items or quantities changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates that the cart has been logically removed or archived but kept for audit or analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_cart_items
models.description:
Line items belonging to a customer’s persistent cart, representing SKU selections and quantities.

Each record corresponds to a specific SKU that an authenticated customer has added to their cart. Items are tightly coupled to their parent customer cart and are updated or removed when the customer changes quantities, removes items, or clears the cart.

The table only captures structural details (product, SKU, quantity). Pricing and promotions are evaluated dynamically during cart retrieval and checkout and are recorded in the order domain instead of this table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the customer cart item. Uniquely identifies a SKU entry within a customer’s cart.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent customer cart that owns this item. {@link shopping_mall_customer_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the base catalog product for this cart item. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific SKU variant chosen by the customer for this cart item. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Requested quantity of the SKU in the customer cart. Must be a positive integer enforced by stock and policy validations at application level.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was first added to the customer cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated, such as quantity adjustments.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates that the item has been logically removed from the cart but retained for audit or analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Customer-owned wishlists that group products or SKUs for future consideration.

Each wishlist belongs to a single authenticated customer and may be the default wishlist that is created at registration. Customers can optionally create additional wishlists, rename them, and manage their contents while their account is active.

Wishlists are used only for planning and discovery and have no direct payment or fulfillment state. They are independent primary entities that can be listed, filtered, and moderated as needed.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the wishlist. Uniquely identifies a single wishlist instance owned by a customer.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who owns this wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the wishlist as chosen by the customer, such as "Default", "Birthday Gifts", or "Ideas".

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this wishlist is the default wishlist for the owning customer. Business logic ensures at most one default per customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist metadata or items were last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates that the wishlist has been logically removed but retained for audit or potential recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Entries within a customer wishlist, referencing either products or specific SKUs.

Each wishlist item associates a wishlist with a target in the catalog. Depending on platform configuration, the target may be the whole product or a particular SKU. To accommodate both modes without separate tables, the record carries foreign keys for product and SKU, with application logic enforcing which field is used for a given entry.

Wishlist items have no independent lifecycle apart from their parent wishlist. They support soft deletion for audit, and they help avoid duplicate entries for the same target within the same wishlist.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the wishlist item. Uniquely identifies a single entry within a wishlist.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent wishlist that owns this entry. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to a product being wished. Used when platform operates with product-level wishlists. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to a specific SKU being wished. Used when platform supports SKU-level wishlists. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates that the wishlist entry has been logically removed but may still be retained for audit or analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Customer-facing master orders representing a checkout result and aggregating items from multiple sellers.

Each order belongs to a single customer and may contain items from multiple sellers via seller segments and order lines. The model stores immutable business snapshots such as order code, currency, and price totals at creation time, as well as mutable lifecycle fields like order_status and payment_status that mirror current business state.

It references customer identity and optionally the originating customer cart for traceability. Historical changes in order and payment status are tracked via {@link shopping_mall_order_status_events}. Cancellation, return, and dispute records reference this entity as their primary context.

Soft deletion is supported for operational removal from primary views while preserving auditability.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the order.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this order. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the customer cart from which this order was created. {@link shopping_mall_customer_carts.id}.

plainFields.name: order_code
plainFields.description: Business order code visible to customers and support. Typically unique and human-readable (for example, 'ORD-20251114-0001').

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary fields in this order snapshot (for example, 'USD' or 'KRW').

plainFields.name: order_status
plainFields.description: Current high-level business status of the order (for example, pending_payment, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded). Managed by order workflows and mirrored by status events.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Current payment status snapshot for this order (for example, payment_pending, payment_captured, payment_failed, partially_refunded, refunded). Synchronized with payment domain events but stored as raw state here.

plainFields.name: items_subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot subtotal of all line items before discounts, taxes, and shipping, recorded at order creation time.

plainFields.name: discount_total_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot total of all discounts applied to this order at creation time, including item-level and order-level promotions.

plainFields.name: shipping_total_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot total shipping cost across all seller segments at order creation time.

plainFields.name: tax_total_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot total tax amount calculated for this order at creation time.

plainFields.name: grand_total_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot grand total amount payable for this order (items_subtotal_amount - discount_total_amount + shipping_total_amount + tax_total_amount).

plainFields.name: customer_note
plainFields.description: Optional free-text note provided by the customer during checkout for sellers or support to see.

plainFields.name: internal_note
plainFields.description: Internal note for support or platformAdmin about this order, not visible to customers.

plainFields.name: placed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was successfully placed after checkout and payment initiation.

plainFields.name: confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was confirmed as ready for fulfillment according to payment and validation rules.

plainFields.name: cancelled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order became fully cancelled, if applicable.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order lifecycle finished successfully (for example, all items delivered and beyond return window).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the order is hidden from normal listings but retained for audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_seller_segments
models.description:
Per-seller segments of a customer order representing the portion of the order handled by a single seller.

Each segment links a {@link shopping_mall_orders} record with a specific {@link shopping_mall_seller}. It aggregates price totals, shipping amounts, and fulfillment status for that seller’s portion of the order.

Sellers operate primarily on these segments for picking, packing, shipping, and after-sales flows such as cancellations and refunds scoped to their items. Soft deletion is supported for operational cleanup while historical data is maintained.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the order seller segment.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order to which this seller segment belongs. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller responsible for fulfilling this segment of the order. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

plainFields.name: segment_code
plainFields.description: Business-visible code that uniquely identifies this seller segment within the order context (for example, 'ORD-20251114-0001-S1').

plainFields.name: segment_status
plainFields.description: Current fulfillment-oriented status for this seller segment (for example, new, preparing, shipped, delivered, cancelled).

plainFields.name: items_subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot subtotal of line items belonging to this seller segment before discounts, taxes, and shipping.

plainFields.name: discount_total_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot total discount amount applied to this seller segment.

plainFields.name: shipping_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot shipping cost charged for this segment only.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot tax amount allocated to this seller segment.

plainFields.name: grand_total_amount
plainFields.description: Snapshot grand total amount for this seller segment (items_subtotal - discounts + shipping + tax).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller segment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller segment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this seller segment. When set, the segment is excluded from normal lists but preserved for audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_addresses
models.description:
Snapshot of shipping and billing addresses associated with an order at the time of checkout.

Addresses are stored as denormalized raw fields so that later changes to customer address book do not affect historical orders. Each record is tied to a {@link shopping_mall_orders} entity and categorized by address_type (for example, shipping or billing).

The model is subsidiary since addresses are managed through order workflows and not independently. A uniqueness constraint ensures at most one address per order and address_type combination.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the order address snapshot.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this address snapshot belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: address_type
plainFields.description: Type of address in relation to the order (for example, shipping, billing). Determines how the address is used during fulfillment and invoicing.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Name of the recipient as provided at checkout for this order address.

plainFields.name: street_line1
plainFields.description: First line of the street address for this order address snapshot.

plainFields.name: street_line2
plainFields.description: Second line of the street address such as apartment, suite, or building information.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City component of the address at the time of order.

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Region, state, or province component of the address at the time of order.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for this order address snapshot.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this address (for example, 'KR' or 'US').

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Recipient contact phone number associated with this address at the time of order.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this address snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this address snapshot record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this address snapshot, used if an address needs to be hidden from standard views.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_lines
models.description:
Individual line items within an order representing concrete SKUs, quantities, and pricing snapshots.

Each line belongs to a {@link shopping_mall_orders} record and optionally to a {@link shopping_mall_order_seller_segments} entity when multi-seller orders are split by seller. Lines reference catalog entities such as {@link shopping_mall_products} and {@link shopping_mall_product_skus} rather than duplicating product attributes, while storing immutable price and tax amounts recorded at order creation.

Lines are primary because they support independent queries across orders, such as seller analytics, fulfillment operations, and item-level cancellation, return, and dispute flows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the order line.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this line item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_seller_segment_id
foreignFields.description: Optional seller segment that is responsible for fulfilling this line. {@link shopping_mall_order_seller_segments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller that owns this item and will fulfill it. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product purchased in this line. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU representing the specific variant purchased in this line. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: product_name_snapshot
plainFields.description: Product name as displayed to the customer at the time of ordering. Stored as raw text to preserve historical names.

plainFields.name: sku_code_snapshot
plainFields.description: Seller-facing or system SKU code value at the time of order, providing historical traceability even if SKU metadata later changes.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of the SKU purchased in this line. Represents the ordered quantity, not necessarily shipped yet.

plainFields.name: unit_price_amount
plainFields.description: Per-unit price of the SKU at the time of order before discounts and tax, in the order currency.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount applied to this line across all units, recorded at order creation.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Total tax amount applied to this line across all units, recorded at order creation.

plainFields.name: line_total_amount
plainFields.description: Final total amount charged for this line after discounts and taxes, recorded at order creation.

plainFields.name: line_status
plainFields.description: Current status of this line from an order and fulfillment perspective (for example, pending, fulfilled, cancelled, returned).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order line record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order line record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this order line, used when the line should not appear in normal operations.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_events
models.description:
Historical log of status transitions for orders, capturing how order and payment states evolve over time.

Each status event is associated with a {@link shopping_mall_orders} record and records the previous and next status values as well as the actor_type and source channel that triggered the change. This provides an audit trail useful for customer support, compliance, and analytics.

The model is subsidiary because it is append-only supporting data for orders and is not managed directly by end users.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the order status event.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order whose status was changed. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_order_status
plainFields.description: Order status value before this transition occurred. Nullable when this is the initial status event for the order.

plainFields.name: next_order_status
plainFields.description: Order status value after this transition occurred.

plainFields.name: previous_payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment status value before this transition occurred. Nullable when no payment state was previously set.

plainFields.name: next_payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment status value after this transition occurred, if the payment state changed as part of this event.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor that triggered the status change (for example, system, customer, seller, platform_admin).

plainFields.name: source_channel
plainFields.description: Channel through which the status change was initiated (for example, api, admin_dashboard, seller_portal, customer_portal).

plainFields.name: reason_category
plainFields.description: Optional category describing why the status changed (for example, payment_confirmed, stock_issue, manual_adjustment).

plainFields.name: reason_detail
plainFields.description: Optional free-text explanation or additional context for the status change event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status event was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status event record was last updated, usually equal to created_at since events are append-only.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this status event, used rarely for operational cleanup while preserving integrity.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_requests
models.description:
Cancellation requests raised against orders or specific order lines, regardless of which actor initiated the request.

This main entity holds shared business fields for all cancellations such as order linkage, optional line linkage, request_reason_category, free-text details, current request_status, and resolution information. It is associated with orders via {@link shopping_mall_orders} and optionally to lines via {@link shopping_mall_order_lines}.

Compatible actor subtypes {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_of_customers} and {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_of_sellers} carry actor-specific foreign keys and sessions, enforcing 1:1 relationships and avoiding multiple nullable FKs. The actor_type field enables filtering by actor class while keeping the core cancellation behavior centralized.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the cancellation request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this cancellation request refers to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_line_id
foreignFields.description: Optional order line that this cancellation request targets, enabling line-level cancellations. {@link shopping_mall_order_lines.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor type that triggered the request (for example, customer, seller, platform_admin). Used for filtering and consistency with subtype tables.

plainFields.name: request_reason_category
plainFields.description: Categorized reason for the cancellation request (for example, changed_mind, ordered_by_mistake, stock_issue, policy_violation).

plainFields.name: request_reason_detail
plainFields.description: Free-text explanation provided by the actor describing why the cancellation is being requested.

plainFields.name: request_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the cancellation request (for example, pending, approved, rejected, cancelled_by_actor).

plainFields.name: resolution_category
plainFields.description: Category describing how the request was resolved (for example, auto_approved, seller_approved, admin_override, rejected_policy).

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request reached a terminal state such as approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cancellation request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this cancellation request record.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_of_customers
models.description:
Customer-specific subtype entity linking a cancellation request to the customer identity and session that created it.

Each record forms a 1:1 relationship with {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellation_requests}, enforced via a unique index on shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_id. It references the {@link shopping_mall_customer} and the {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions} used when issuing the request.

This model is subsidiary because it is managed through the main cancellation request lifecycle and is not manipulated independently from business workflows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the customer cancellation request subtype record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: Cancellation request main record that this customer subtype details. {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellation_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated this cancellation request. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Customer session used when submitting the request, providing audit context. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this customer subtype record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this customer subtype record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this customer subtype record.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_of_sellers
models.description:
Seller-specific subtype entity linking a cancellation request to the seller identity and session that created it.

Each record represents a cancellation request initiated by a seller for their own order lines or segments. It forms a 1:1 relationship with {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellation_requests} via a unique index. Actor-specific context such as seller and seller session are retained here instead of in the main table to preserve normalization.

The model is subsidiary and accessed through cancellation request workflows and seller dashboards rather than managed independently.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the seller cancellation request subtype record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: Cancellation request main record that this seller subtype details. {@link shopping_mall_order_cancellation_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who initiated this cancellation request. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_session_id
foreignFields.description: Seller session used when submitting the request, enabling audit and risk analysis. {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller subtype record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller subtype record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_return_requests
models.description:
Return or refund requests initiated for delivered order items, usually by customers within the allowed return window.

The main entity captures common attributes such as the target order and optional specific line, actor_type (normally customer but extensible), reason category and details, requested resolution, and request_status. It also stores resolution information such as resolution_category and resolved_at.

It is complemented by the subtype {@link shopping_mall_order_return_request_of_customers}, which ties the request to the customer and session. Financial refund transactions are handled by the Payments component, which references this entity when necessary.

plainFields.name: requested_resolution

plainFields.name: request_status

plainFields.name: resolution_category
plainFields.description: Category describing how the request was resolved (for example, refund_issued, replacement_shipped, denied_policy).

plainFields.name: resolved_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

It is subsidiary because it is managed exclusively through return request workflows and serves to preserve actor context for audit, fraud analysis, and customer service traces.

primaryField.name: id

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id

models.name: shopping_mall_order_disputes
models.description:
Disputes raised in relation to orders, order lines, or after-sales interactions, covering complaints such as non-delivery, damaged goods, or service dissatisfaction.

This main entity contains shared dispute data including links to {@link shopping_mall_orders}, optional {@link shopping_mall_order_lines}, actor_type, issue_category, description, dispute_status, and resolution information. It is complemented by subtype entities for customer and seller perspectives.

Disputes provide a central record for platformAdmin to resolve conflicts and interact with payment chargebacks, refunds, and inventory corrections, while preserving a full timeline of interactions from different actors.

foreignFields.description: Optional specific order line that the dispute targets when it is line-level. {@link shopping_mall_order_lines.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type

plainFields.name: issue_category

plainFields.name: issue_title

plainFields.name: issue_description

plainFields.name: dispute_status

plainFields.name: resolution_category
