models.name: shopping_mall_payment_methods
models.description:
Configurable payment methods available on the shoppingMall platform.

Stores the catalog of conceptual payment methods such as credit card, bank transfer, and digital wallet as they are exposed to checkout. Each method is linked to a payment provider integration and can be enabled or disabled over time.

The table is used by payment transactions to record which method was chosen for a given order. Admin users manage these rows as business configuration, adjusting display names, ordering, and availability windows without touching historical financial records.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the payment method.

foreignFields.name: created_by_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who initially created this payment method configuration. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

foreignFields.name: updated_by_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Most recent administrator who updated this payment method configuration. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business identifier for the payment method, unique across the platform, such as "card", "bank_transfer", or a provider-specific key.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human readable name shown to customers at checkout, such as "Credit Card" or "Bank Transfer".

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer description of the payment method, including business notes or eligibility information.

plainFields.name: provider_key
plainFields.description: Identifier of the underlying payment provider configuration that should be used when processing this method, for example a gateway code or profile key.

plainFields.name: method_type
plainFields.description: Logical type of the payment method, such as "card", "bank", "wallet", or "offline". Used for business rules and reporting.

plainFields.name: currency_restriction
plainFields.description: Optional list or pattern of currencies that this method supports, encoded as a business string when a method is not globally available.

plainFields.name: min_amount
plainFields.description: Optional minimum order amount in the platform currency for which this payment method is allowed.

plainFields.name: max_amount
plainFields.description: Optional maximum order amount in the platform currency for which this payment method is allowed.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Display priority for this payment method in checkout lists. Lower values are shown earlier.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this payment method is currently available for new checkouts.

plainFields.name: starts_at
plainFields.description: Optional datetime after which this payment method becomes eligible for use in checkout.

plainFields.name: ends_at
plainFields.description: Optional datetime after which this payment method should no longer appear in checkout selections.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method row was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp used to hide this method from configuration lists while keeping historical references intact.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_transactions
models.description:
Customer payment transactions associated with shoppingMall orders.

Represents the platform-level payment record for an order, independent of the underlying provider implementation. Each transaction references the order it pays for, the payment method chosen at checkout, and key provider identifiers used for reconciliation.

The table captures amounts authorized and captured, the current business payment status, and links to associated authorization and capture attempts, refund transactions, chargebacks, and status events. It forms the core of financial reporting for incoming payments.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the payment transaction.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this payment transaction is associated with. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns the order and initiated the payment. Nullable for edge cases where the customer record is unavailable. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method used for this transaction at checkout time. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: payment_intent_key
plainFields.description: Optional platform-side identifier grouping multiple provider interactions for the same logical payment intent, such as an internal intent code.

plainFields.name: provider_name
plainFields.description: Name or code of the payment provider handling this transaction, such as a gateway identifier.

plainFields.name: provider_transaction_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the transaction at the payment provider, used for reconciliation and support inquiries.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for the amounts in this transaction, for example "USD" or "EUR".

plainFields.name: authorized_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that has been successfully authorized by the provider but not necessarily captured yet.

plainFields.name: captured_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that has been successfully captured from the provider for this transaction.

plainFields.name: refunded_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that has been refunded against this payment transaction, aggregated from refund transactions.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Business payment status for the order, such as "payment_pending", "payment_in_progress", "payment_authorized", "payment_captured", "payment_failed", "payment_expired", "partially_refunded", or "refunded".

plainFields.name: provider_status
plainFields.description: Raw or provider-specific status code representing the latest known state of the provider transaction.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional code describing why the payment failed, using either platform-defined or provider-defined categories.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional human readable message explaining why the payment failed or could not be processed.

plainFields.name: requires_manual_review
plainFields.description: Indicates that this payment transaction requires manual investigation or review due to risk signals or inconsistencies.

plainFields.name: metadata_json
plainFields.description: Optional JSON-encoded metadata from business logic or the provider. Only raw data is stored; interpretation happens in application code.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment transaction record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment transaction record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_authorizations
models.description:
Authorization attempts associated with payment transactions.

Each row represents a single authorization interaction with a payment provider for a given payment transaction. It stores provider authorization identifiers, amounts, and status codes, and supports multiple attempts or re-authorizations where business policy allows.

This table acts as supporting audit detail for {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions} and is not typically manipulated directly by end users, but it is important for troubleshooting and reconciliation.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the payment authorization attempt.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Payment transaction that this authorization attempt belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}.

plainFields.name: provider_authorization_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the authorization at the payment provider, used to reference or capture funds later.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount that was requested for authorization in the transaction currency.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for the authorization amount, matching the parent payment transaction.

plainFields.name: authorization_status
plainFields.description: Business status for this authorization attempt, such as "authorized", "authorization_failed", or "authorization_voided".

plainFields.name: provider_status
plainFields.description: Raw status code returned by the provider for this authorization attempt.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the authorization is expected to expire according to provider rules.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional code describing why the authorization failed when the status represents a failure.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional human readable explanation describing authorization failure returned by the provider or produced by the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this authorization record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_captures
models.description:
Capture attempts for previously authorized payment transactions.

Each row records a capture interaction with the payment provider, which moves funds from an authorized state to a captured state. The design supports multiple partial captures against the same authorization or payment transaction and records provider identifiers and status codes for each attempt.

These records provide fine-grained audit trails that complement the aggregate captured_amount stored on {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the payment capture attempt.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Payment transaction that this capture attempt belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_authorization_id
foreignFields.description: Authorization record that this capture is based on, when a specific authorization was used. {@link shopping_mall_payment_authorizations.id}.

plainFields.name: provider_capture_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the capture at the payment provider, used for reconciliation.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount that was requested to be captured in this attempt, expressed in the transaction currency.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for the capture amount, matching the parent payment transaction.

plainFields.name: capture_status
plainFields.description: Business status for this capture attempt, such as "capture_succeeded" or "capture_failed".

plainFields.name: provider_status
plainFields.description: Raw status code from the provider describing the capture result.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional code describing why the capture failed when capture_status indicates failure.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional human readable message describing capture failure details.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this capture record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_status_events
models.description:
Status and event history for payment transactions.

Captures an append-only stream of state changes, notifications, and significant events related to a payment transaction. This includes transitions between business payment statuses, asynchronous webhooks from providers, and manual changes triggered by admins.

The table provides a detailed timeline for troubleshooting, analysis, and compliance investigations and complements the current payment_status on {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the payment status event.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Payment transaction that this status event belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator responsible for this event when it represents a manual override or adjustment. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: Payment status before this event was applied, using the same business vocabulary as payment_status on the transaction.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Payment status after this event was applied, using the same business vocabulary as payment_status on the transaction.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Categorized type of status event, such as "provider_webhook", "manual_update", or "system_transition".

plainFields.name: provider_event_code
plainFields.description: Optional raw event code from the provider when the event was triggered by an external notification.

plainFields.name: provider_reference
plainFields.description: Optional reference identifier from the provider, such as an event ID or notification ID.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional human readable notes describing the reason or context for this status change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status event was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_transactions
models.description:
Refund transactions that return funds to customers for all or part of an order.

Each row represents a distinct refund event against a payment transaction and order. It stores the refunded amount, reason categories, and status, and provides links to the underlying payment transaction and order for reconciliation.

Refunds may be triggered by customers, sellers, or platform admins. The table records the initiating actor type and identifiers and is complemented by {@link shopping_mall_refund_items} for line-level breakdowns and {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions} for the original payment context.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund transaction.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Payment transaction that this refund is applied to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order whose financial amounts are being refunded. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: initiator_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated the refund request when it originates from the buyer. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

foreignFields.name: initiator_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who initiated the refund when the request originates from the merchant side. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

foreignFields.name: initiator_platformadmin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who initiated or approved the refund when it is an admin-driven adjustment. {@link shopping_mall_platformadmin.id}.

plainFields.name: refund_number
plainFields.description: Business identifier for the refund transaction, unique per payment for audit and customer communication.

plainFields.name: refund_status
plainFields.description: Business status of the refund, such as "refund_pending", "refund_in_progress", "refund_failed", or "refund_completed".

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Categorical type of the actor that initiated the refund, such as "customer", "seller", or "admin". Used for reporting and business rules.

plainFields.name: reason_category
plainFields.description: Categorized reason for the refund, such as "customer_cancellation", "seller_cancellation", "return", or "admin_adjustment".

plainFields.name: reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional free text explanation describing why the refund was requested or approved.

plainFields.name: requested_amount
plainFields.description: Amount initially requested to be refunded in the payment currency.

plainFields.name: approved_amount
plainFields.description: Amount that was approved for refund, which may be less than the requested_amount according to policy.

plainFields.name: refunded_amount
plainFields.description: Amount actually refunded through the provider once the refund is completed.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for all amounts, matching the currency of the payment transaction.

plainFields.name: provider_refund_id
plainFields.description: Identifier for this refund at the payment provider, used for reconciliation and support.

plainFields.name: provider_status
plainFields.description: Raw status code from the payment provider describing the current state of the refund.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional code describing why the refund failed when refund_status indicates a failure.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional message giving more detail about a refund failure.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund transaction record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund transaction record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_items
models.description:
Line-level breakdown of amounts within a refund transaction.

Each row represents a component of a refund, such as a specific order line, shipping portion, or manual adjustment. This allows the platform to explain which parts of an order were refunded and to match refund amounts to item-level and fee-level amounts.

The table is managed as a child of {@link shopping_mall_refund_transactions} and may reference order lines or seller segments defined in the order domain.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Refund transaction that this item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_refund_transactions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_line_id
foreignFields.description: Order line that this refund item relates to, when the refund targets specific items. {@link shopping_mall_order_lines.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_seller_segment_id
foreignFields.description: Seller segment that this refund item relates to when the refund is computed at seller-scope instead of a single line. {@link shopping_mall_order_seller_segments.id}.

plainFields.name: component_type
plainFields.description: Type of amount being refunded, such as "item_price", "tax", "shipping", or "adjustment".

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of this refund component, suitable for customer-facing explanations.

plainFields.name: gross_amount
plainFields.description: Gross amount of this refund component before any fees, expressed in the refund currency.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of tax included in this refund component when tax needs to be reported separately.

plainFields.name: shipping_amount
plainFields.description: Portion of shipping cost included in this component when applicable.

plainFields.name: net_amount
plainFields.description: Net amount of this refund component after subtracting non-refundable fees if any are applied by the business.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund item record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_chargebacks
models.description:
Chargebacks raised through financial institutions against completed payments.

Represents disputes initiated outside the platform, typically via a customer’s bank or card issuer. Each record groups information about the chargeback case, including the amount contested, provider reason codes, and the current chargeback status.

These rows link back to the original payment transaction and order and are used by platform admins and finance teams to manage responses, report loss due to chargebacks, and align with dispute-handling policies.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the chargeback record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_transaction_id
foreignFields.description: Payment transaction that this chargeback relates to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_transactions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order whose payment is being disputed through the chargeback. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer associated with the order under dispute. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

plainFields.name: case_reference
plainFields.description: Platform-side identifier for the chargeback case, unique per payment transaction for internal tracking.

plainFields.name: provider_case_id
plainFields.description: Identifier for the chargeback case at the payment provider or card network.

plainFields.name: chargeback_status
plainFields.description: Current business status of the chargeback, such as "chargeback_open", "chargeback_won", or "chargeback_lost".

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Provider or scheme reason code indicating why the chargeback was opened, such as fraud, non-receipt, or product dissatisfaction.

plainFields.name: reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional human readable explanation or description associated with the reason code.

plainFields.name: disputed_amount
plainFields.description: Amount that is being disputed through the chargeback, expressed in the payment currency.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for the disputed amount, usually matching the original payment currency.

plainFields.name: opened_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the chargeback was first reported to the platform.

plainFields.name: closed_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the chargeback case was closed, either in favor of the customer or the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this chargeback record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this chargeback record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_payouts
models.description:
Payout batches that transfer funds from the platform to individual sellers.

Each row aggregates net earnings, adjustments, and fees for a seller over a payout period, and maps them to a single outbound payment to the seller, such as a bank transfer. The table tracks payout status and provider identifiers and is the root for {@link shopping_mall_seller_payout_items} that detail per-order allocations.

Finance and accounting teams use this entity to reconcile platform liabilities and to report on what has been paid out or is still pending for each seller.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the seller payout.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller that receives this payout. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

plainFields.name: payout_number
plainFields.description: Business identifier of the payout, unique per seller for reconciliation and communication.

plainFields.name: payout_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the payout, such as "payout_pending", "payout_in_progress", "payout_failed", or "payout_sent".

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO currency code of the payout, usually the settlement currency agreed with the seller.

plainFields.name: gross_amount
plainFields.description: Total gross amount of all positive earnings included in this payout before fees and adjustments.

plainFields.name: fee_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount of fees or commissions deducted from the seller as part of this payout.

plainFields.name: adjustment_amount
plainFields.description: Net effect of manual adjustments, such as manual credits or debits, included in this payout.

plainFields.name: net_amount
plainFields.description: Net amount that is actually paid out to the seller after fees and adjustments.

plainFields.name: period_start
plainFields.description: Optional start of the earnings period covered by this payout, used for reporting and reconciliation.

plainFields.name: period_end
plainFields.description: Optional end of the earnings period covered by this payout, used for reporting and reconciliation.

plainFields.name: provider_name
plainFields.description: Name or code of the external payment provider or bank used to send this payout.

plainFields.name: provider_payout_id
plainFields.description: Identifier for this payout at the provider or bank, used for tracing payouts.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional code describing why the payout failed when payout_status indicates failure.

plainFields.name: failure_reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional human readable description giving more information about a payout failure.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_payout_items
models.description:
Per-order and per-line components included in a seller payout.

Each row represents a specific contribution to a seller payout such as revenue from a particular order line, a refund adjustment, or a manual correction. This breakdown links payout amounts back to underlying orders and seller segments to support transparent statements and reconciliation.

The table is a child of {@link shopping_mall_seller_payouts} and relies on order-centric tables for the underlying commercial context.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the seller payout item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_payout_id
foreignFields.description: Seller payout that this item contributes to. {@link shopping_mall_seller_payouts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this payout item is derived from when applicable. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_seller_segment_id
foreignFields.description: Seller segment of the order that this payout item relates to, when allocation is tracked at segment level. {@link shopping_mall_order_seller_segments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_line_id
foreignFields.description: Order line that this payout item relates to when the payout is calculated at line level. {@link shopping_mall_order_lines.id}.

plainFields.name: component_type
plainFields.description: Type of component included in the payout, such as "item_revenue", "shipping_revenue", "refund_deduction", or "manual_adjustment".

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional explanation shown in seller statements for this payout component.

plainFields.name: gross_amount
plainFields.description: Gross amount for this payout component before deducting platform fees.

plainFields.name: fee_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of platform fees allocated to this component when available.

plainFields.name: net_amount
